_doc: Crewmate gifts and asks, sent as GIFT records (lv/record.py) and merged like any choice. give = can be sent unasked, ask = can be asked for. {A} sender, {T} receiver, {item}. The order of items is part of the record format: append only, never reorder. STUBS: the content pass replaces these.

sys.give: {A} sends {T} {item} on the next cargo transfer.
